source_annotations.annotation: All 390 Go files in the complete pinned Global Edition tree were searched for the trigger names and literal selector calls. ProbeSite/ResolveDomain occur in method/interface declarations and comments; no literal selector call was found. Engine construction and SetEnrich wiring do not establish a request. Keep artex-enrich/1.0 and the request-construction combination as source-present capability, not confirmed runtime target egress.
